1. Failed setup deletes shared metrics 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>Both newRegistrationId implementations add an ID to registeredIds before the corresponding
>registry operation succeeds, and clearMetrics() removes every recorded ID. If a later registration
>is rejected because the shared registry already contains an incompatible metric with the same name
>and tags, expiration or endpoint cleanup can delete that existing metric even though this updater
>never registered it.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[core/src/main/java/com/datastax/oss/driver/internal/core/metrics/DropwizardMetricUpdater.java[112]](https://github.com/scylladb/java-driver/pull/1461/files#diff-ab97bef9bb741f38cce4d544a0a744017bc32738280d55bd52778203bc55adadR112-R112) > >```diff >+ registeredIds.put(metric, id); >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Both metric updaters record IDs before registration succeeds. A failed registration leaves an ID that later cleanup can use to remove another metric from the shared registry. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- core/src/main/java/com/datastax/oss/driver/internal/core/metrics/DropwizardMetricUpdater.java[99-185] >- metrics/microprofile/src/main/java/com/datastax/oss/driver/internal/metrics/microprofile/MicroProfileMetricUpdater.java[90-176] > >## Recommended Fix >In both updaters, record each ID only after its registry operation succeeds. Keep registration and cleanup coordinated so cleanup cannot run between successful registration and recording the ID.
